steps.title: Market Curves
steps.say: Buyers want more at lower prices, while sellers supply more at higher prices. Together, demand and supply meet in the market.

steps.title: Market Equilibrium
steps.say: Where the two curves cross, quantity demanded equals quantity supplied. This intersection determines the market price.

steps.title: Supply Decreases
steps.say: Suppose bad weather ruins crops, so supply falls and the entire supply curve shifts to the left.

steps.title: New Equilibrium
steps.say: Because goods are scarcer, buyers compete for fewer items, driving the equilibrium price up and the quantity down.

steps.title: Explore the Market
steps.say: Try dragging the curves yourself to see how various shifts in supply and demand affect market price and quantity.
